templates.title: Cursor · MCP server (static key)
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) or .cursor/mcp.json (project). Reload Cursor after editing.

templates.title: Cursor · MCP server (OAuth)
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.cursor/mcp.json. On first MCP tool use Cursor will open a browser tab to authorize against the Streamscope gateway.

templates.title: Cursor · Custom LLM (UI setup)
templates.instructions:
Cursor's LLM provider config is UI-driven, not file-driven. To point Cursor at the Streamscope gateway:

1. Open Cursor → Settings (⌘,) → Models.
2. Scroll to **OpenAI API Key** and toggle on **Override OpenAI Base URL**.
3. Paste the base URL: `{{base_url}}`
4. Paste the API key: `{{api_key}}`
5. Under **Add model**, add an entry for `{{model_alias}}`.
6. Click **Save** then **Verify** — Cursor sends a probe request through the gateway.

Vision and tool calling are auto-detected from request content; no explicit capability flag is needed on the Cursor side.
